content.thinking: The objective needs a schema before the endpoints, and the UI after the endpoints. Tests touch their own files so they can be a separate activity.

content.text: {"title":"JWT authentication for the backend API","nodes":[{"id":"db_schema","title":"Add the user and refresh-token tables","description":"Create an Alembic revision adding `user` and `refresh_token`. `user` holds id, email (unique), password_hash and created_ms; `refresh_token` holds id, user_id, expires_ms and a revoked flag. Define the SQLModel classes in backend/app/models/tables.py. Do not touch anything under backend/app/api/.","depends_on":[],"acceptance_criteria":["alembic upgrade head applies cleanly on an empty database","alembic downgrade -1 removes both tables","uv run mypy app passes"],"suggested_harness":"claude-code","suggested_model":"claude-sonnet-5","estimated_effort":"small","touches":["backend/app/models/tables.py","backend/migrations/versions/**"]},{"id":"auth_api","title":"Implement the authentication endpoints","description":"Add POST /api/auth/login, POST /api/auth/refresh and POST /api/auth/logout in a new backend/app/api/auth.py, registered on the app router. Issue a 15-minute access token and a 30-day refresh token persisted in the refresh_token table added by the schema activity. Passwords are verified against user.password_hash.","depends_on":["db_schema"],"acceptance_criteria":["POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials returns 200 and both tokens","POST /api/auth/login with a wrong password returns 401 and no token","A revoked refresh token is rejected with 401"],"suggested_harness":"claude-code","suggested_model":"claude-opus-5","estimated_effort":"medium","touches":["backend/app/api/auth.py","backend/app/api/__init__.py"]},{"id":"auth_ui","title":"Add the login route to the frontend","description":"Add frontend/src/routes/Login.tsx and register it at /login in the router. It posts to /api/auth/login, stores the access token in the auth store and redirects to /dashboard on success, showing the server's message on 401.","depends_on":["auth_api"],"acceptance_criteria":["pnpm typecheck passes","A failed login shows an error and does not navigate"],"suggested_harness":"codex","suggested_model":"gpt-5.6-terra","estimated_effort":"medium","touches":["frontend/src/routes/Login.tsx","frontend/src/router.tsx"]},{"id":"auth_tests","title":"Cover the authentication flow end to end","description":"Add backend/tests/api/test_auth.py covering login, refresh, logout and revocation, and a Playwright spec at frontend/e2e/login.spec.ts covering a successful and a failed login. Only add files under those two paths.","depends_on":["auth_api","auth_ui"],"acceptance_criteria":["uv run pytest tests/api/test_auth.py passes","The Playwright login spec passes against a running dev server"],"suggested_harness":"claude-code","suggested_model":"claude-haiku-4-5","estimated_effort":"small","touches":["backend/tests/api/test_auth.py","frontend/e2e/login.spec.ts"]}]}
